description: Answer a buyer's quote request or counter their purchase order with priced terms: the seller's own proposal on the buyer's thread. The buyer's rules or agent accept, counter, or decline it.

buyer.description: The buyer's gerp_id (who asked, or who proposed the PO being countered).

thread.description: The buyer's thread: the quote request's or the PO's. A new row lands on it; the history stays.

lines.description: The priced terms, each {description, amount, sku?, qty?}. sku is THIS firm's item id; qty the count offered. amount is the line total.

sku.description: This firm's item id for the line, from its own inventory.

memo.description: Optional note carried on the row.

location.description: This firm's location ordinal that fulfils the order, default '1'. Private to this firm; the invoice drafted on agreement carries it.
